generated.notes: Hand-transcribed fixture, not machine-generated. Covers only 3rd Week of Trinity 2026 (Sun 2026-05-10 to Sat 2026-05-16) for three venues: magdalen (boys-and-men foundation), merton (student-mixed college) and keble (Anglo-Catholic, minimally-structured list). Built so the site has a realistic term file to render before the update pipeline exists; its shape matters more than its coverage. Trinity 2026 is not in the university term table in docs/sources-survey.md (which starts at Michaelmas 2026); term.weekOneSunday and term.lastSaturday here were read off the Trinity 2026 sample lists (Wadham 'FIRST WEEK Sunday 26th April', Oriel 'First Week - 26 April', 'Third Week - 10 May'). Said Morning Prayer, midday said Eucharists, organ recitals and one-off memorial/wedding services are omitted: only sung choral services are recorded. Scripture readings and sermons are not part of music[] and are not captured. Magdalen superscripts an 'M' against composers with a Magdalen connection; that mark is dropped here. Merton's music-list PDF download URL is reconstructed from the filename recorded in the survey. Music text is verbatim from each list with whitespace normalised.
